name: ANSI/IEEE Three-wire touch-sensitive switch form
summary: IEEE-library form of three-wire touch-sensitive switch: this representation distinguishes a separately supplied three-wire touch-switch interface.
description: This reference locates three-wire touch-sensitive switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented touch switches family. This representation distinguishes a separately supplied three-wire touch-switch interface. The public library uses HPX11TS3 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
